answer: Each address must advance its own verifiable delay chain, one sequential step per minute, and reward weight grows only with completed steps. A step cannot be parallelised or borrowed, so a clone born today starts at zero, and n clones need n cores running for the whole wall-clock time. A comet of fresh accounts therefore earns almost nothing, while patient agents that wander through every epoch on one chain, like a willow growing ring by ring, steadily gain weight.
